<STBG 1,0><BGM 0,0,507><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,3,0><CV 1,15>We did it!
Now we're explorers too!

<CV 1,47><CHAR 1,0,1,2,0>An explorer is the general term for
those who study the Fractured Isles.

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CHAR 5,1,8,5,0><CV 2,5>You lot have become fine explorers,
so how about a new group name, nya?

<CHAR 5,1,8,4,3><CV 2,5>That's it, nya!
How about 「Lord Argo & Minions」, nya?

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,15>Nya nya? You don't like it, nya?
Then 「Self-Styled Pioneers」, nya!

<TALK 5><NAME 9><CV 2,7>Such a fussy one, nya!
「Rift Realm Castaways」!
How about that, nya!

<TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,1><CV 1,62>What even is that!?
We haven't even entered the Fractured Isles!

<MWT 2>Thus, after a long half-day of discussion,
the team name was... postponed.
